01About

Biomedical engineer from Lima, Peru, building AI systems that move the needle in healthcare. I studied at Tecnológico de Monterrey and spent six months at the Fetal Neonatal Neuroimaging and Developmental Science Center (FNNDSC) from Boston Children's Hospital and Harvard Medical School, where I co-authored research on deep generative models for fetal brain anomaly detection.

Currently, I lead a team of three at Laboratorios Bagó del Perú, shipping GenAI products used by 120+ medical representatives and developing clinical tools targeting thousands of physicians. My work spans the full stack: from LLM orchestration and RAG pipelines to A/B testing frameworks and cross-functional change management.

I care about building technology that is rigorous, useful, and accessible.
